testcase.name: PostgreSQL 17: All dictionary tables, enabled/trusted NO ACTION FKs and required indexes exist
PostgreSQL 17: Case-insensitive username/team uniqueness, Thai/Unicode and memberships enforce boundaries
PostgreSQL 17: UTF16 text storage matches DTO limits including emoji and Thai trailing spaces
PostgreSQL 17: Subtask/comment/attachment/admin records enforce FK, JSON, UUID, byte and version boundaries
PostgreSQL 17: Date-only leap boundaries and UTC millisecond timestamps serialize as provider-independent primitives
PostgreSQL 17: Task enums, recurrence links/anchor, optional UNIQUE, completion and trash pairs enforce consistency
PostgreSQL 17: Board uniqueness is immediate; negative ranks support two-phase swaps and status/project FKs
PostgreSQL 17: Explicit purge retains recurrence tombstones and cleanup snapshots, with no identity reuse
PostgreSQL 17: Quota, reservations, cleanup, idempotency, sessions and maintenance survive reopen
PostgreSQL 17: Actual task/audit/notification writes commit atomically and roll back when an effect fails
PostgreSQL 17: Fresh/repeat/legacy upgrade preserve data; changed, missing and partial-failure migrations are rejected atomically
